title: Guide yl
text:
Our guide Irene was fantastic  and
her  historic knowledge and ability  to interact with the group was superb. She really brough the experience to  life.  I do think that the time  provided for this tour is unrealistic and places unessary stress on the tour group and the guide and limits the interaction between both.  To do justice to it
It needs at least an extra 30 minutes. Please take this on board
author: harryo2015
